title: Isomorphism descent for fixed finitely presented modules from an elementwise ring colimit
statement: Let J be a directed preorder and A_j commutative rings, with ring maps f_jl for j≤l satisfying f_jj=id and f_lm∘f_jl=f_jm. Let C be a commutative ring with compatible ring maps g_j:A_j→C. Assume every c∈C is g_j(a) for some j,a, and if g_j(a)=0 then f_jl(a)=0 at some l≥j. Fix i∈J and finitely presented A_i-modules P,N [def-sc-finitely-presented-module]. Give C and A_j (j≥i) their A_i-algebra structures using g_i and f_ij. If C⊗_{A_i}P≃_C C⊗_{A_i}N, there is a j≥i such that A_j⊗_{A_i}P≃_{A_j}A_j⊗_{A_i}N. The ring, index and two module universes are independent. This statement descends to one stage only; it assumes no tensor presentation of the ring diagram, no auxiliary coefficient rings and no flatness.

proof.text: Restrict to the upper tail K = {j | i ≤ j}, which is inhabited and directed even when J is only a preorder. Give A_j and C their A_i-algebra structures using f_ij and g_i. The composition and cocone laws make the transition maps and g_j A_i-linear. Move every coefficient representative above i and retain eventual zero on this tail. This is constructed explicitly in the Lean proof, without a poset reflection or universe lifts.

In the proved private helper tensor_elementwise, lift the compatible maps A_j → C to q : Module.DirectLimit A_j → C. Surjectivity is the representative assumption. For injectivity, represent two classes at stages j,k, take a common l, and apply eventual zero to f_jl(a)-f_kl(b); their representatives then agree at a later stage. Thus q is a linear equivalence. Apply TensorProduct.directLimitLeft (the directed form of Tag 00DD) and tensor q with either fixed module. Check the comparison on pure tensors. Module.DirectLimit.exists_of and of.zero_exact give tensor representatives and eventual tensor zero. The ring, index, and module universes remain independent.

The proved private helper fp_lift implements Tag 05LI (3) on an arbitrary elementwise module system. Choose a finite free cover π of the finitely presented source and finite generators of ker π. Represent the images of its finitely many generators at a common stage. Their linear combination a₀ agrees with the limit map after π. Images of the finitely many kernel generators vanish at the limit, so move to a common later stage killing them. The transported a₀ kills ker π and therefore factors through the quotient and the proved quotient-to-source equivalence. Apply this helper to p ↦ e(1 tensor p) and n ↦ e⁻¹(1 tensor n), then move both maps to a common stage l. Scalar extension by liftBaseChange gives A_l-linear maps U,V. Their extensions agree with e,e⁻¹ by tensor induction, as proved in tensor_lift_limit.

Form A_i-linear error maps p ↦ V(a(p)) - 1 tensor p and n ↦ U(b(n)) - 1 tensor n in the two stage tensor modules. The compatibility from tensor_lift_limit and the inverse identities for e show both errors vanish over C. The proved helper eventually_zero_hom takes finite generators of the source, kills their error images at a common stage using eventual tensor zero, and extends equality from their span. Apply it to both errors and take a common upper stage m. The transition composition laws keep both errors zero at m.

Transport a and b to m and apply liftBaseChange to obtain Um,Vm. The proved tensor_lift_naturality identifies the transport of each composite error with the corresponding composite on unit tensors at m. Both composites fix every unit tensor. Scalar linearity then fixes every pure tensor, so AlgebraTensorModule.ext gives Vm∘Um=id and Um∘Vm=id. LinearEquiv.ofLinearMap builds the required equivalence at m. All helpers are proved with no sorry. Empty generating or relation sets, zero modules and rings use the inhabited tail rather than a chosen finite generator.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_stage_equiv_of_elementwise_colimit
    {J : Type v} [Preorder J] [IsDirectedOrder J]
    (A : J → Type u) [∀ j, CommRing (A j)]
    (f : ∀ (j l : J), j ≤ l → A j →+* A l)
    (hself : ∀ j, f j j le_rfl = RingHom.id (A j))
    (hcomp : ∀ j l m (hjl : j ≤ l) (hlm : l ≤ m),
      (f l m hlm).comp (f j l hjl) = f j m (hjl.trans hlm))
    (C : Type w) [CommRing C] (g : ∀ j, A j →+* C)
    (hg : ∀ j l (hjl : j ≤ l), (g l).comp (f j l hjl) = g j)
    (hsurj : ∀ c : C, ∃ j a, g j a = c)
    (hzero : ∀ j a, g j a = 0 → ∃ (l : J) (hjl : j ≤ l), f j l hjl a = 0)
    (i : J) (P : Type x) (N : Type y) [AddCommMonoid P] [AddCommMonoid N]
    [Module (A i) P] [Module (A i) N]
    [Module.FinitePresentation (A i) P] [Module.FinitePresentation (A i) N]
    (e : letI : Algebra (A i) C := (g i).toAlgebra
      Nonempty (C ⊗[A i] P ≃ₗ[C] C ⊗[A i] N)) :
    ∃ (j : J) (hij : i ≤ j),
      letI : Algebra (A i) (A j) := (f i j hij).toAlgebra
      Nonempty (A j ⊗[A i] P ≃ₗ[A j] A j ⊗[A i] N)
